mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for 3 months, or the signal fails to generate negative returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which signals weakening economic activity and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or the signal produces positive returns in more than 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a severe supply-side contraction, which increases uncertainty about corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, it signals a tightening monetary regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (proxied by RSAFS) combined with a drop in housing starts indicates a collapse in consumer demand, which triggers a bearish equity market reaction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or positive returns occur in more than 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 6.0% and a decline in payroll employment below 137 million signals a labor market breakdown, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth, combined with a decline in industrial production, signals a deepening economic slowdown that triggers a bearish equity market reaction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of weak GDPC1 and low INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered cases.
